description: Premium landscape rendering with dramatic but believable tonal depth, vibrant natural color, exceptional local detail, atmospheric separation, and maximum visual impact suitable for commercial stock photography.
editing_goals: Produce an immediately striking landscape with strong commercial thumbnail impact while remaining completely believable.
Build bold tonal separation with brilliant highlights, rich shadow depth, clean white points, and well-controlled black points.
Create obvious foreground, midground, and background separation using local contrast, atmospheric depth, and selective dehaze.
Enhance sky, clouds, mountains, forests, water, rock, snow, desert, and foliage with rich but natural color.
Reveal fine landscape texture and micro-detail without creating crunchy edges or HDR artifacts.
Recover highlight and shadow detail whenever supported by the RAW file.
Prefer premium travel-magazine quality over technically neutral rendering.
cautions: Never create an artificial HDR or tone-mapped appearance.
Avoid halos around mountains, trees, skylines, ridges, or clouds.
Avoid neon foliage, cyan water, oversaturated sunsets, or unrealistic blue skies.
Avoid clipping important highlight detail in clouds, snow, waterfalls, or reflections.
Avoid muddy shadows or excessive shadow lifting that removes depth.
Apply maximum intensity only when the scene genuinely supports it.
Respect fog, mist, rain, haze, snowfall, and low-contrast weather rather than forcing every scene into high contrast.

guidance: Correct genuine horizon, coastline, lake, sea, river, and distant mountain skyline tilt.
Do not use naturally sloping hills, dunes, glaciers, waterfalls, or terrain as a false horizon.
Preserve intentional dramatic camera angles when they clearly enhance the composition.
Prioritize believable landscape geometry over mathematically perfect leveling.
